RÉPUBLIQUE DU BURUNDI

MINISTERE DES FINANCES, DU BUDGET ET DE L’ECONOMIE NUMERIQUE

PROJET D’APPUI AUX FONDATIONS DE L’ECONOMIE NUMERIQUE AU BURUNDI « PAFEN »

Pays : Burundi

N° du projet : P 1763967

Don N° : E0930-BI

Références : BI-PAFEN-PIU-1.3.3.2_3-CS-QCBS

Emis le : 1/9/2026

 

AVIS A MANIFESTATION D’INTERET

(SERVICES DE CONSULTANTS)

SÉLECTION DE FIRMES/CABINETS

 

RECRUTEMENT D’UN CABINET POUR L’ORGANISATION DES TOURNÉES DE FORMATION DES NOUVEAUX FORMATEURS TIC ET DES JEUNES, LE LANCEMENT ET L’ANIMATION DEs CLUBS NUMÉRIQUES EXTRASCOLAIRES DANS LES TÉLÉCENTRES COMMUNAUTAIRES

Le Gouvernement de la République du Burundi a reçu un don de 92 million de dollar USD de la Banque mondiale pour financer le coût du Projet d’Appui aux Fondations de l’Economie Numérique dont l’objectif de développement est d’accroitre l’accès à l’internet haut débit en particulier pour les communautés mal desservies et d’améliorer la capacité du gouvernement à gérer les ressources plus efficacement et fournir les services publics par voie numérique.

Il a l’intention d’utiliser une partie de ce financement pour effectuer des paiements au titre du contrat pour « Elaborer des modules, assurer des formations des formateurs, de lancer et d’animer des clubs numériques extrascolaires dans les télécentres communautaires »

L'objectif est d’assurer la formation d’un pool de formateurs TIC et organiser des sessions de renforcement de capacités en compétences numériques de base dans huit (8) télécentres communautaires, ainsi qu’assurer le lancement et l’animation des clubs numériques extra scolaires.

Plus spécifiquement, il s’agira notamment de :

  • Développer des modules de formation adaptés aux diverses communautés (jeunes, adultes, filles, femmes et associations, etc …);
  • Identifier, mobiliser et former 200 nouveaux formateurs TIC ;
  • Lancer et animer des clubs TIC extra Scolaires dans les télécentres communautaires en TIC actualisés ;
  • Organiser des tournées de formation en présentiel dans les 8 télécentres communautaires ;
  • Former au moins 10 000 jeunes filles et garçons aux compétences numériques de base et intermédiaires ;
  • Certifier les formateurs dans le domaine des TIC selon les modules développés ;
  • Promouvoir la participation dans les club numériques extra scolaires.

Durée de la mission (indicative)

  • 10 à 15 jours par cohorte selon le niveau.
  • La durée de la mission est de douze (12) mois à compter de la signature du contrat.

La zone d’intervention est sur tout le territoire National incluant les cinq provinces du pays (BUHUMUZA, BUJUMBURA, BURUNGA, BUTANYERERA, GITEGA).

Les centres de formation sont les huit (8) télécentres communautaires se trouvant dans les cinq provinces du pays (BUBANZA, RUMONGE, RUYIGI, KIRUNDO, KARUSI, MAKAMBA, MWARO, CIBITOKE).

Les Termes de référence peuvent être téléchargés sur le site du PAFEN : https://pafen.gov.bi/appels-doffres/  ou obtenus aux adresses mentionnées ci-dessous.

L’Unité de Gestion du PAFEN invite les consultants (firmes)/institutions spécialisés, ayant une expérience et expertise dans le déploiement et le suivi des projets de déploiements de réseaux de télécommunications/TIC intéressés par la présente mission à fournir des informations démontrant qu'ils disposent des qualifications requises et de l'expérience pertinente pour l’exécution des services.

Critères d’établissement de la liste restreinte :  

  • Etre légalement enregistré au Burundi ;
  • Justifier d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans : la formation TIC, l’éducation numérique, l’animation communautaire, les projets de jeunesse.
  • Avoir réalisé au moins 3 missions similaires ;

Pour être acceptables, les références doivent indiquer le projet, bailleur de fonds, l’année de réalisation, et le montant du contrat. Les références seront soutenues par des copies des contrats et des certificats de bonne fin de mission.

Les Experts clé ne sont pas évalués au stade de la présélection stade.

L’attention des Consultants intéressés est attirée sur la Section III, paragraphes 3.15, 3.16 et 3.17 du « Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement des Projets d’Investissement (FPI) de la Banque mondiale, édition de novembre 2020 (« Règlement de Passation des Marchés relatifs aux règles de la Banque mondiale en matière de conflit d’intérêt).

En outre, veuillez-vous référer aux informations spécifiques sur les conflits d’intérêts liées à cette mission comme énoncés au paragraphe 3.17 du Règlement de Passation des Marchés.

Les consultants peuvent s’associer à d’autres firmes pour renforcer leurs compétences, mais ils doivent indiquer clairement si l’association prend la forme d’un groupement solidaire (joint-venture) et / ou d’un accord de sous-traitant. Dans le cas d'un groupement solidaire (joint-venture), tous les partenaires du groupement solidaire (joint-venture) seront conjointement et solidairement responsables de la totalité du contrat, s’ils sont sélectionnés.

Un consultant sera sélectionné par la méthode de Sélection Fondée sur la Qualité et le Coût (SFQC) telle que décrite dans le Règlement de Passation des Marchés.

De plus amples informations peuvent être obtenues à l’adresse ci-dessous pendant les heures de bureau: de 9H :00 à 12H :00 et de 15 H: 00 à 16H: 30 heure locale de lundi à jeudi et de 8H: 00 à 12H: 00 les vendredi (heure de Bujumbura: GMT+2)

Les manifestations d'intérêt écrites doivent être remises par écrit à l'adresse ci-dessous par courrier ordinaire ou par e-mail au plus tard le 18 Septembre 2026 à 12 heures (heure de Bujumbura, GMT+2) avec la mention :

« REPONSE A L’AVIS DE SOLLICITATION DES MANIFESTATIONS D'INTERET N°BI-PAFEN-PIU-1.3.3.2_3-CS-QCBS PORTANT SUR LE RECRUTEMENT D’UN CABINET POUR L’ORGANISATION DES TOURNÉES DE FORMATION DES NOUVEAUX FORMATEURS TIC ET DES JEUNES LE LANCEMENT ET L’ANIMATION DE CLUBS NUMÉRIQUES EXTRASCOLAIRES DANS LES TÉLÉCENTRES COMMUNAUTAIRES »

procnotices.notice_text:
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (REOI)

(CONSULTING SERVICES)

Firms Selection

Climate Resilience and Agriculture Development Project in Albania

Project ID Number: P178715

IBRD Loan Number: 94890

Assignment Title: “Preparation of detailed designs and construction supervision plans for all facilities (for clusters in Berat and Diber)”

Reference: AL-MARD-527716-CS-CQS

The World Bank is assisting the Government of Albania (GoA) with the financing of the Climate Resilience and Agriculture Development project (CRAD). This project aims to increase competitiveness and climate resilience of priority agri-food value chains focusing on (i) promoting climate smart and resilient value chains,  (ii) promoting typical products and value addition (iii) developing Climate Smart Agriculture (CSA) IT Platform (iv) modernizing selected irrigation and drainage schemes for high-value agricultural production (v) enhancing compliance with food safety and quality standards and (vi) strengthening evidence-based decision making for resilience and sustainable agri-food systems.

The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development (MARD) seeks the consulting services of a qualified consulting firm/consortium to provide asistance for “Preparation of detailed designs and construction supervision plans for all facilities (for clusters in Berat and Diber)”.

The Consultant will be responsible for providing qualified professional and supporting staff and all necessary services required for the efficient cost effective and timely execution of the Consultancy Services.  

  1. OVERALL OBJECTIVE OF THE ASSIGNMENT

The objective of the assignment is to carry out a detailed  design for the two clusters in each of the locations (Berat and Dibra) and environmental and social management plans in order to assess the pertinent risks and supervision of construction works of Civil Works.

  1. SCOPE OF WORK

The Consultant shall carry out all necessary activities for the preparation of technical design, documentations and supervision planning for the rehabilitation and upgrading of two facilities:

  1. in Berat for table olive and olive oil
  2. in Dibra for fruits & vegetables facilities.

The Consultant shall prepare the detailed technical design in full compliance with Albanian building codes and legal provisions, and in line with EU standards for facilities/premises for two clusters.

The scope includes, but is not limited to, the following tasks:

Scope of Detailed Design and Technical Specifications

  • The Consultant shall design the facilities based on clearly defined product categories, realistic seasonal production volumes and operational scenarios, ensuring food safety compliance, technical functionality and long-term operational flexibility.
  • Prepare all preliminary surveys, topographic maps, review of all existing conditions such as structural stability of existing buildings and installations, access, or any other necessary study before any other activity.
  • Prepare complete detailed design for implementation including not only the architectural design, structural, mechanical, electrical designs but also any specific system and installation design that are linked to the functionality and purpose of the investment for each facilities (in Berat and Dibra).
  • Ensure all designs comply with national construction standards and relevant EU norms for agro-industries infrastructure.
  • Include provisions for agro-industries workflow, HVAC systems, waste management, and storage conditions.
  • Preparation of Technical Reports and Detailed Designs for the construction/ rehabilitation of the two facilities
  • Preparation of Bill of Quantities and Cost Estimates, Technical Specifications;
  • The necessary assistance for the Project Management Team (PMT) at the MARD, and the Berat and Dibra Municipalities in the process of approving projects and obtaining the necessary permits from the relevant institutions;
  • Preparing the necessary ESMP or EIE plans and reports for investors evaluation as well as for permit application if needed.
  • Prepare the interior design, materials palete and equipment to be supplied for clusters
  • Designing the appropriate production lines and storage system capacities to serve the scope.
  • Assure the high functionality of the cluster centres by designing the appreciate elements through similar experiences that the designer may have.
  • Supervision of civil works for the construction/ rehabilitation of the two facilities

Scope of Supervision Consultant

To assist the Client for the satisfactory completion of the construction of the Civil Works, the activity of the Consultant is divided into these phases:

  • Design and assistance in the preparation of the Tender Documents for the Civil Works and the Technical Specifications
  • Supervision of Civil Works.
  • Commissioning and functional testing of processing lines and equipment;
  • Performance testing of cold storage and HVAC systems;
  • Support during the initial operational start-up period;
  • Provision of basic operational training to facility staff
  1. CONSULTANT QUALIFICATION

The contract will be awarded following a Consultant’s Qualifications Based Selection (CQS) procedure in accordance with the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers “Procurement in Investment Project Financing Goods, Works, Non-Consulting and Consulting Services (July 2016, Revised November 2017, August 2018, November 2020). The Consultant may associate with other Consultants in the form of a joint venture or of a sub-consultancy agreement to complement their respective areas of expertise, strengthen their technical responsiveness of their proposals, make available bigger pool of experts, provide better approaches and methodologies. 

Firm Qualifications

The Consultant shall be a firm or group of firms with following minimum qualifications:

  • The Consultant should be an reputable consultancy firm with demonstrable knowledge and experience of at least 10 years in general design, preferably in design preparation of Food Technology, Agro-Industrial Engineering Design, environmental and social requirements, design engineering and supervision of the work for similar projects preferably related to agricultural facilities;
  • At least 3 similar contracts implemented during the last 10 (ten) years in detailed design/ supervision and preferably of work in agri-food facilities – logistics facilities – fresh fruits and vegetables agrologistics projects, processing facilities;
  • Previous experience with the World Bank projects will be an advantage.

The applicants will be assessed in order to determine a shortlist comprising the most qualified firms. The criteria to be used for shortlisting will be the following:

  • Core business and years in business – 30 points
  • Past experience in similar assignments – 60 points
  • Availability of qualified staff among the firm to perform the assignment – 10 points

Evaluated Grid

Points

Core business and years in business

60

Firms’ organization and staffing

Total

100

The CVs of Key experts will not be evaluated during the shortlisting process. 

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” July 2016 revised November 2020 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

The Consultant will be selected in accordance with the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers: "Procurement in Investment Project Financing of Goods, Works, Non-Consulting and Consulting Services" (November 2020), using the Consultant Qualification Selection (CQS) method.

Interested Consultants may obtain further information concerning the Terms of Reference at the official website of MARD: https://bujqesia.gov.al/projekti-qendrueshmeria-ndaj-klimes-dhe-zhvillimit-ne-bujqesi/, or at the address below, during office hours 09:00 to 15:00 (Monday to Thursday) and 09:00 to 13:00 on Friday.

Expressions of Interest (EoI) in English language must be delivered no later than September 15, 2026 hardcopy (in person or by mail) to the address below, within office hours, and/or electronically at the below e-mail address.

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (REOI)

CONSULTANT’S QUALIFICATIONS BASED SELECTION (CQS)

Name of Project

Country of Delivery

Bosnia and Herzegovina (Republika Srpska)

The Ministry of Finance and Treasury of Bosnia and Herzegovina (the “Borrower”) has received financing from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) toward the cost of the Sustainable, Integrated and Safe Road Infrastructure Project (SISRI) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for the following consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) comprise construction supervision, project management and contract administration for the rehabilitation of the main road MII-504 (R-454), Konjevi Polje - Bratunac (Works RFB No. BA-RS-SISRI-W-RFB-26-1.2.3), covering approximately 23.9 km. The Works include pavement rehabilitation and strengthening; earthworks and drainage; shoulders and roadside elements; repair of culverts and related structures; traffic signage and road markings; safety barriers and other road safety equipment; bus-stop treatments; temporary traffic management; and environmental, social, occupational health and safety measures.

The Intended Completion Date for the Works is 365 days after the Commencement Date. The Services are expected to commence in coordination with the commencement of the Works and to cover the construction period and the related completion, close-out and Defects Liability Period services as specified in the Terms of Reference. The Defects Liability Period under the Works contract is 730 calendar days. The detailed scope, deliverables, level of effort and implementation arrangements are set out in the Terms of Reference.

The Terms of Reference (TOR) for the primary procurement stage for the assignment can be obtained at the address given below.

The Public Company “Republic of Srpska Roads” Ltd. now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to paragraphs 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers: “Procurement Investment Project Financing Goods, Works, Non-Consulting, and Consulting Services, Seventh edition, September 2025”  (“the Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

The best qualified firm to carry out the Services will be selected in accordance with the Consultant’s Qualifications Based Selection (CQS) method set out in the Regulations and based on the following criteria:

Qualification requirements to be met by the Consultant:

1. Core business and general experience: at least seven (5) years of demonstrated experience in construction supervision, project management and/or contract administration of road or transport infrastructure works.

2. Relevant specific experience: successful completion, within the last ten (10) years, of at least two (2) assignments for supervision and contract administration of construction, reconstruction or rehabilitation of paved public roads of similar nature and complexity; at least one such assignment should have involved a road section or combined road sections of not less than approximately 20 km.

3. Similar technical scope: demonstrated firm-level experience supervising asphalt pavement rehabilitation, earthworks and drainage, culverts and roadside elements, traffic signage and road markings, safety barriers and other road safety equipment, temporary traffic management under live traffic conditions, and environmental and social requirements.

4. Technical and managerial capability: demonstrated organizational and management capacity for quality assurance/quality control, supervision of materials testing, measurement and certification of works, progress and cost control, contract administration, environmental and social compliance, occupational health and safety monitoring, and regular reporting.

5. Previous experience with World Bank or other international financial institution (IFI/MDB)-financed road infrastructure projects and related contract administration procedures will be considered an asset;

6. Experience in Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Western Balkans or comparable legal, climatic and operating environments will be considered an asset;

Interested Consultants should submit a concise company profile and evidence of relevant assignments, including the client, country, scope, duration, implementation period, value of the supervised works where available, the Consultant’s role, and client contact details for verification. In the case of an association, the Expression of Interest should clearly state the form and proposed role of each member/partner.

The qualifications and experience of individual Key Experts shall not be evaluated at the REOI stage and CVs of Key Experts are not required with the Expression of Interest.

Evaluation criteria:

Consultants meeting the minimum qualification requirements set out above will be evaluated and ranked on the basis of their demonstrated qualifications and relevant experience related to the assignment. The evaluation will be based on the information submitted in the Expressions of Interest and in accordance with the following criteria:

  1. Core business, general experience and organizational capacity of the firm (20%)
  2. Relevant experience in supervision and contract administration of road projects of similar nature, scope and complexity (60%)
  3. Technical and managerial capability demonstrated through previous assignments (20%)

PROJET DE RENFORCEMENT DE L’ÉDUCATION POUR AMÉLIORER LES RÉSULTATS EN MATIÈRE DE CAPITAL HUMAIN (P507220)

****************

UNITE DE GESTION DE PROJET (UGP- PFSS-RRC/PREMCH)

AVIS D’APPEL A CANDIDATURE POUR LE RECRUTEMENT D’UN CONSULTANT NATIONAL POUR L’ELABORATION DES GUIDES ET OUTILS DE COMMUNICATION EN LANGUE NATIONALE ET DU CARNET DES PARENTS

Date de l’avis : 01 Septembre 2026

Financement Projet N° P507220

Don N°E4100-KM

Contexte

D’une manière générale, l'Union des Comores à travers le Ministère de l’Education Nationale, de l’Enseignement, de la Recherche Scientifique, de la Formation et de l’Insertion Professionnelle s’associe et participe à l’Approche Programmatique Multiphase (APM) pour promouvoir des méthodes innovantes pour favoriser l’apprentissage en Afrique de l’est et australe. L’APM proposée, intitulée « Advancing Innovative Methods to Promote Learning » (AIM4Learning) ou Favoriser des méthodes innovantes pour promouvoir l’apprentissage, intègre des approches résolument nouvelles pour offrir une meilleure éducation aux élèves.

Cependant, l’Union des Comores a subi ces dernières années des chocs et des perturbations qui ont fortement impacté le système éducatif du pays, accentué les pertes d’apprentissages, les profondes inégalités scolaires et les risques d’exclusion scolaire des groupes les plus vulnérables. Il est nécessaire de rétablir et sauvegarder l’éducation en tant que droit fondamental, vecteur de développement, facteur de réduction de la pauvreté et levier puissant pour la paix, la résilience aux changements climatiques et au développement durable.

C’est ainsi que le Gouvernement comorien a obtenu un Don de l’Association International de Développement (IDA) et du Fonds du Partenariat mondial pour l’éducation équivalent à 23,7 millions de dollars pour répondre aux besoins du pays en matière d’amélioration et du renforcement de l’éducation pour l’amélioration des Résultats en Matière de Capital Humain aux Comores.

Il est prévu qu’une partie des sommes accordées au titre de ce Don sera utilisée pour effectuer le paiement à titre du contrat portant « Recrutement d’un consultant national pour l’élaboration des guides et outils de communication en langue nationale et du carnet des parents ».

Le Consultant sera recruté Conformément au « Règlement de Passation des Marchés dans le Cadre du Financement de Projets d’investissements (FPI) Fournitures, Travaux, Services Autres que des Services de Consultants et Services de Consultants », 7ème Edition- Septembre 2025.

La méthode de sélection est la « Sélection de Consultants Individuels (SCI) ».

Profil et qualifications du consultant

Le consultant devra répondre aux qualifications suivantes :

  • Être titulaire d’un diplôme universitaire (au moins Bac +4) en communication, sciences sociales, éducation, développement communautaire ou domaine connexe ;
  • Justifier d’au moins 5 années d’expérience dans la conception d’outils de communication sociale ou de sensibilisation communautaire ;
  • Avoir une expérience confirmée dans la production de supports pédagogiques simplifiés destinés aux communautés ;
  • Avoir une bonne connaissance du contexte socioculturel des Comores ;
  • Maîtriser parfaitement le français et la langue nationale comorienne ;
  • Une expérience dans des projets financés par des partenaires techniques et financiers sera un atout.

Composition des dossiers de candidature :

  • Curriculum vitae détaillé et coordonnées pour contact rapide
  • Lettre de motivation datée et signée
  • Copies des diplômes et des attestations
  • Copie de la carte d’identité biométrique 
  • Copies des attestations de bonne exécution des missions similaires
  • Expérience spécifique dans des produits comparables
  • Communication comportementale et adaptation aux publics
  • Compétences éditoriales, graphiques et multimédias
  • Noms, adresses, téléphones des personnes de références à contacter

Les dossiers de candidatures portant la mention suivante peuvent être déposées au Secrétariat de la Coordination nationale à l’adresse mentionnée ci-dessous au plus tard le 14 septembre 2026 à 15 heures 30 (heure locale) avec la mention suivante :

« Recrutement d’un consultant national pour l’élaboration des guides et outils de communication en langue nationale et du carnet des parents ».

NB : Le dépôt en ligne n’est pas autorisé

Pour toutes informations complémentaires, veuillez consulter les Termes de Références (TDR) dans le site Web : pfss-comores.org/ www.pfss-comores.org

procnotices.notice_text:
Project Name Caribbean Digital Transformation Project (CARDTP)

Loan/Credit/Grant No. IDA Credit #6682-LC

Assignment Title: Consultancy for the Development of a Government of Saint Lucia (GOSL) Secure Wallet with Digital Payment and Integration Solutions

Reference No: LC-DPS-513171-CS-QCBS

Country: Saint Lucia

1. Background The Government of Saint Lucia has received financing from the International Development Association (IDA) (the “Bank”) in the form of a Credit toward the cost of the Caribbean Digital Transformation Project. The Ministry of the Public Service, Transport, Information and Utilities Regulation, as the implementing agency, intends to apply a portion of the proceeds of the Credit to eligible payments under the contract for the Consultancy for the Development of a Government of Saint Lucia Secure Wallet with Digital Payment and Integration Solutions.

2. Objective of the Assignment The objective of the assignment is to design, develop and implement a secure Government of Saint Lucia Government Secure Wallet with an integrated Digital Payment System, secure document-management capabilities and integration with relevant Government services and platforms.

3. Scope of the assignment To deliver this objective, the Consultant will be required to undertake a comprehensive set of technical, operational, and regulatory activities, including the following:

Conduct detailed requirements gathering and analysis to inform system design and functional specifications.

Develop the overall system architecture and technical design for the Government Wallet and digital payment solution.

Build secure, scalable mobile and web applications supporting wallet functions and digital payments.

Integrate the solution with existing government platforms, including digiGov and the National Authentication Framework.

Implement secure digital payment capabilities and related documentmanagement features.

Incorporate cybersecurity, privacy, and dataprotection controls aligned with international standards.

Establish business continuity and disaster recovery arrangements for the solution.

Deliver user training, operational guidance, and structured knowledgetransfer activities.

Provide warranty support to ensure stability and performance during the initial operational period.

Prepare all necessary documentation and support the Government of Saint Lucia in securing regulatory approval for the Government Wallet, including assessment of the FinTech legal and regulatory framework to ensure compliance with existing laws and policies

Deploy the solution within the hosting infrastructure provided by the Client, including servers, storage, networking, virtualization platform, and operating systems, and configure all required components to ensure full operational readiness

4. Duration of the assignment The estimated duration of the Services is 50 weeks.

5. Shortlisting Criteria Interested Consulting Firms will be shortlisted based on the following criteria:

i. At least five (5) years of proven experience in the design, development and implementation of digital payment platforms, Government Secure Wallets or comparable FinTech solutions.

ii. Demonstrated experience integrating ICT or payment systems with government platforms, databases or service portals, including the use of application programming interfaces (APIs) and authentication services.

iii. Proven experience in developing and deploying secure, scalable web and mobile applications with strong user-experience and interoperability features.

iv. Demonstrated capacity to implement secure solutions aligned with internationally recognized standards, including PCI DSS, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO 20022 or equivalent standards.

v. Successful completion of at least three (3) assignments of similar scope and complexity, such as national-level payment systems, e-government platforms or enterprise-level systems-integration assignments.

vi. Demonstrated experience delivering assignments for public-sector clients in the Caribbean, the Organization of Eastern Caribbean States (OECS) or comparable jurisdictions.

vii. Prior experience managing assignments financed by international development partners, such as the World Bank, Caribbean Development Bank or United Nations Development Programme, will be considered an advantage.

Interested Consulting Firms must provide sufficient information to demonstrate that they possess the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The information submitted should include:

a) a profile of the firm and a description of its core business;

b) details of relevant experience in digital payment platforms, Government Secure Wallets, FinTech solutions, secure mobile and web applications, government-system integration and cybersecurity;

c) descriptions of comparable assignments, including the name of the client, country, scope of services, contract period, completion status and contact information for verification; and

d) details of any proposed joint-venture member or sub consultant and the nature of the proposed association.

Key Experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage. Therefore, individual experts’ CVs are not required with the Expression of Interest.

A firm may submit an Expression of Interest (EOI) individually if it considers itself fully qualified to undertake the assignment. Consultants may also form a joint venture or sub consultancy with other firms should they wish to enhance their qualifications and capacity.

The Attention of interested Consultants is drawn to paragraphs 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (July 2016, revised), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest. A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost-Based Selection method set out in the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers. Expressions of interest must be delivered in a written form to the address below (in person, or by mail, or by e-mail) by Midnight, EST, Monday September 7, 2026

procnotices.notice_text:
REPUBLIQUE DU NIGER

Fraternité – Travail – Progrès

----------------------------------------

MINISTERE DE L’URBANISME ET DE L’HABITAT

 

 

                             PROJET INTEGRE DE DEVELOPPEMENT URBAIN ET DE RESILIENCE MULTISECTORIELLE (PIDUREM)

 

 

Avis Spécifique d’Appel d’Offres
(Processus d’Appel d’Offres à deux Enveloppes sans Préqualification)

République du Niger

Maître d’Ouvrage : Ministère de l’Urbanisme et de l’Habitat

Projet : Projet Intégré de Développement Urbain et de Résilience Multisectorielle (PIDUREM)

Référence : Pret N°7083-NE

N°STEP: NE-PIDUREM-549163-CW-RFB

Titre du Marché : TRAVAUX DE REALISATION DES OUVRAGES DE DRAINAGE (COLLECTEURS, CANIVEAUX, CHAUSSEES DRAINANTES) ET CHAUSSEE BITUMEE DANS LES VILLES DE MARADI ET ZINDER ET LA COMMUNE URBAINE DE DIFFA  

Référence de l’AOI : AOI N° 003/TRAVAUX/PIDUREM/2025

Emis le : Septembre 2026

1.__ Le Gouvernement de la République du Niger a obtenu un prêt de la Banque mondiale pour financer le coût du Projet Intégré de Développement Urbain et de Résilience Multisectorielle et a l’intention d’utiliser une partie des sommes accordées au titre de ce financement pour effectuer les paiements prévus au titre du marché pour les TRAVAUX DE REALISATION DES OUVRAGES DE DRAINAGE (COLLECTEURS, CANIVEAUX, CHAUSSEES DRAINANTES) ET CHAUSSEE BITUMEE DANS LES VILLES DE MARADI ET ZINDER ET LA COMMUNE URBAINE DE DIFFA

2.__ Le PIDUREM invite, par la présente, les Soumissionnaires à présenter leurs Offres sous pli fermé, pour la réalisation des TRAVAUX DE REALISATION DES OUVRAGES DE DRAINAGE (COLLECTEURS, CANIVEAUX, CHAUSSEES DRAINANTES) ET CHAUSSEE BITUMEE DANS LES VILLES DE MARADI ET ZINDER ET LA COMMUNE URBAINE DE DIFFA répartis en cinq (05) lots comme suit :

  1. Lot 1 : Travaux de réalisation de 2102 ml de chaussée bitumée et de 5 907 ml de caniveaux/collecteurs et d'aménagement de la mare de Dankaro dans la ville de Zinder
  2. Lot 2 : Travaux de réalisation de 2 460 ml de canal et 150 ml de traversée en dalot cadre de 200x150 au niveau du dalot SONIDEP -Tapkin Tafsa - Karkada Gaon police
  3. Lot 3 : Travaux de réalisation de la chaussée drainante Derrière Brigade-Douane-Sonitel Diffa Koura, + caniveaux Collecteur RN1-Gendarmerie-Caniveau ONAHA et Radio alternative-Caniveau ONAHA-Komadougou dans la Commune Urbaine de Diffa
  4. Lot 4 : Travaux de réalisation Travaux de réalisation de la chaussée drainante Rue Janjouna-CSI Ali Chaibou-descente garage Liba CD sur 450 ml + caniveaux Collecteur Intersection dalot-INRAN dans la Ville de Maradi
  5. Lot 5 : Travaux de réalisation Travaux de réalisation de la chaussée drainante Rue derrière bureau Maman Issa + caniveaux Collecteur Compagnie militaire-Intersection dalot +caniveaux Collecteur Place Sultanat-Collecteur Yandaka Col 376 ml dans la Ville de Maradi

Les travaux prévoient également la mise en œuvre de mesures environnementales et de sauvegarde sociale y compris les Violences Basées sur le Genre, les Exploitations, Abus Sexuel et/ou Harcèlement sexuel.

Le délai d’exécution des travaux pour chaque lot est de 8 mois.

3.         La procédure sera conduite par mise en concurrence internationale en utilisant un Appel d’Offres tel que défini dans le « Règlement de Passation de Marchés de la Banque mondiale pour les Emprunteur de FPI » septième édition (septembre 2025) et ouvert à tous les Soumissionnaires de pays éligibles tels que définis dans le Règlement de Passation de Marchés.

4.         Les Offres seront évaluées conformément au processus d'évaluation défini dans le dossier d'appel d'offres. Les pondérations suivantes s'appliqueront aux Critères notés (y compris les facteurs techniques et autres que le prix) : 70% pour l’offre technique et pour le coût de l'Offre : 30%.

5.         Les Soumissionnaires éligibles peuvent obtenir des informations supplémentaires auprès de l’Unité de Gestion du projet et examiner le Dossier d’Appel d’Offres durant les heures de bureau du lundi au jeudi de 8 h 00 à 17 h 00, et le vendredi de 8 h 00 à 12 h 00 (Heure locale = GMT + 1) à l’adresse indiquée ci-dessous.

6.         Le Dossier d’Appel d’offres en français peut être acheté par tout Soumissionnaire éligible intéressé en formulant une demande écrite à l’adresse ci-dessous contre un paiement[1] non remboursable de cent cinquante mille (150 000) francs CFA. La méthode de paiement sera par dépôt direct sur le compte « DAO PIDUREM » N0251133017001/06 ouvert à la Banque Islamique du Niger (BIN). Le dossier d’appel d’offres sera adressé par dépôt direct des documents hard accompagnés d’un fichier électronique ou par voie électronique.

7.         Les Soumissions doivent être remises à l’adresse ci-dessous au plus tard le 20/10/2026 à 10h. Le dépôt des offres par voie électronique est permis. Toute Soumission reçue en retard sera écartée. Les enveloppes extérieures de l’Offre marquées « ORIGINAL DE L’OFFRE », et les enveloppes intérieures marquées « PARTIE TECHNIQUE » seront ouvertes en présence des représentants des Soumissionnaires et de toute personne qui souhaitent assister à l’ouverture des plis à l’adresse indiquée ci-dessous : Quartier Koira Kano BP : 10 932 Niamey. Téléphone: 20 75 20 72 Email : pidurem@gmail.com le 20/10/2026 à 10h30mn. Toutes les enveloppes marquées « PARTIE FINANCIERE » demeureront non-ouvertes et seront conservées dans un lieu sûr par le Maître d’Ouvrage jusqu’à la seconde ouverture publique des Offres. Le soumissionnaire pourra procéder à la remise de son offre par courrier électronique dans les conditions ci-après :

a) Pour la soumission des propositions, les soumissionnaires enverront (avant l’heure limite de dépôt des offres) leur Offre Technique et leur Offre Financière par courrier électronique (e-mail) en pièces jointes protégés par deux mots de passe distincts, aux adresses électroniques suivantes : maitrehamanis@gmail.com avec copie à morousadou@yahoo.fr  et

b) Les soumissionnaires enverront pour l’offre technique et l’offre financière : (1) une version « originale » en format PDF non modifiable, et (2) une version « copie » éditable (Excel/Word) pour en faciliter l’exploitation pendant l’évaluation des offres. Le mot de passe de l’offre technique doit être différent de celui de l’offre financière.

c) Le mot de passe de l’offre financière sera envoyé uniquement au moment de l’ouverture des offres financières. La date de l’ouverture des offres financières sera fixée par le Client et notifiée aux soumissionnaires dont les offres ont été retenues à l’issue de l’évaluation de leur offre technique.

d) Les soumissionnaires et le Client devront, chacun de son côté, vérifier dans leurs boîtes de réception e-mail et dans les boîtes SPAM, la réception des documents électroniques de l’Appel d’Offre, ou des offres électroniques, ainsi que de toute communication connexe.

e) Le Client confirmera la réception de chaque offre par e-mail à défaut les soumissionnaires doivent en exiger.

f) Les propositions ne peuvent être ouvertes avant l'heure fixée pour l'ouverture des propositions indiquées.

g) Les documents originaux peuvent être demandés dans le cadre du processus d'évaluation et seront vérifiés par le Client avant la signature du Marché.

h) Le procès-verbal d'ouverture des propositions sera partagé avec tous les soumissionnaires par courrier électronique.

i) Les représentants des soumissionnaires peuvent néanmoins assister physiquement à la séance d’ouverture des offres. Ceux qui ne peuvent pas y assister en personne pourront se joindre virtuellement dans la mesure où les facilités techniques du Client le permettent.

À la réception d'une demande de présence virtuelle, le soumissionnaire recevra du Client les détails de la connexion qui sera éventuellement mise en place (Visio ou Audioconférence).

8.     Les Soumissions doivent être accompagnées (i) d’une Garantie d’offre, pour un montant de :

  1. Lot 1 :  35 000 000 FCFA
  2. Lot 2 :  28 000 000 FCFA
  3. Lot 3 :  21 000 000 FCFA
  4. Lot 4 :  16 000 000 FCFA
  5. Lot 5 :  17 000 000 FCFA

(ii) d’une Déclaration relative à l’Exploitation et aux Abus Sexuels (EAS) et/ou au Harcèlement Sexuel (HS), et (iii) d’une Déclaration d’Engagement de la main d’œuvre locale.

9.     Veuillez noter que le Règlement de Passation des Marchés exige que l’Emprunteur divulgue les informations sur les propriétaires effectifs du Soumissionnaire attributaire, dans le cadre de l’avis de Notification d’Attribution de Marché, en renseignant le Formulaire de Divulgation des Bénéficiaires Effectifs inclus dans le dossier d’appel d’offres.

procnotices.notice_text:
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION)

 

 

Country: Grenada

 

Project: Resilient Renewable Energy Infrastructure Investment Facility (P180831)

 

Loan No.: Credit No./ Grant No.: IDA-77510

 

Assignment Title: Owner’s Engineer for Pre- Construction and Construction of a Dual Circuit Transmission Network, Substation and Associated System otherwise referred to as (“the Project”)

 

Reference No.: GD-MCRERE-537637-CS-QCBS

 

The Government of Grenada (GOG) has secured funding through the World Bank (WB) to pursue the Renewable Energy Infrastructure Investment Facility (RREIIF). The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to increase the share of utility-scale renewable energy generation and private-sector participation in renewable energy development in Grenada.

 

The Owner’s Engineer is expected to (i) review and optimize the preliminary survey, routing and the corresponding scoping, cost estimate and engineering design work (including grid integration, resilience and future solar PV interconnections) and technical specifications for each activity of the Project which was prepared previously and to be provided by the client; assist in the preparation bidding documents for each procurement package, including technical specifications; (ii) support the Client in bidding process; and (iii) support GRENLEC otherwise known as (“the Client”) for contract management and carry out construction supervision of the entire Project, which also includes the implementation of any ESMP requirements, (iv) support the Client during the defects liability period.

 

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be obtained on the Government E-Procurement Portal https://in-tendhost.co.uk/gnd/aspx/Home

 

The implementation period will be from January 2027 to January 2031

 

The Government of Grenada now invites eligible multi-discipline engineering consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.  The Qualifications and Experience of Key Experts shall not be included in the shortlisting criteria and will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage.

 

The shortlisting criteria are:

  • Relevant experience of the firm in, supporting utilities in Renewable Energy Integration projects in the last seven years.
  • Experiences in providing similar services in Caribbean and in countries with similar conditions
  • At least 15 Years in business, performing the Owners Engineer role.
  • Reference from past projects, considering client satisfaction and project quality.
  • Prior experience of the firm working on World Bank funded projects is preferable
  • Capability of providing Resident Engineer Services

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” February 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.  In addition, please refer to the following specific information on conflict of interest related to this assignment: The Bank requires that firms or individuals involved in Bank IPF procurement shall not have a conflict of interest.

 

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

 

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

 

Expressions of interest must be submitted via the E-Procurement portal (https://in-tendhost.co.uk/gnd/aspx/Home.), on or before September 24th, 2026.

 

Further information can be obtained from donica.modeste@procurement.gov.gd  during office hours 9:00 am to 3:00 pm.

REPUBLIC OF ANGOLA

MINISTRY OF PLANNING

ACCELERATING ECONOMIC DIVERSIFICATION AND JOB CREATION PROJECT

Loan No.: IBRD-95270

Project ID: P178035

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION)

Assignment Title: CONSULTING SERVICES FOR TRAINING AND CERTIFICATION FOR INSOLVENCY JUDGES AND ADMINISTRATORS  

Reference No. 82CS1/MINPLAN/26

The Government of Angola has received financing from the World Bank Group's International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) toward the cost of the Accelerating Economic Diversification and Job Creation Project (Diversifica Mais) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services for training and certification for insolvency judges and administrators.

The consulting services (“the Services”) consist of:

  1. Design, development and delivery of specialized training programs for judges and insolvency administrators on business recovery and insolvency, in accordance with the Angolan legal framework;
  2. Organization and certification of training courses for judicial and related professionals involved in corporate recovery and insolvency proceedings;
  3. Preparation of training content and materials, covering, among others, the following areas: (i) Legal framework for business recovery and insolvency; (ii) Commercial law; (iii) Labour law; (iv) Civil procedure law; (v) Accounting and taxation; (vi) Economics and business management; (vii) Insolvency, economic development and the business environment;
  4. Implementation, monitoring and evaluation of the training activities, including assessment of participants and issuance of certificates upon successful completion;
  5. Preparation and submission of the required deliverables, including the training plan, teaching materials, training reports and certification documentation.

The assignment includes legal, institutional, procedural, accounting, tax, economic, business management and capacity-building work, structured around the preparation, implementation, evaluation and certification of training activities for judges and insolvency administrators.

The expected duration of the services cannot exceed 12 months.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be obtained at the address given below.

The Accelerating Economic Diversification and Job Creation Project (Diversifica Mais) now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The shortlisting criteria are:

  1. To be legally constituted and authorized to operate in the areas of consulting, training, capacity building or professional certification.
  2. Demonstrate at least 5 years of consolidated experience in providing consulting services, curriculum design, and implementation of training programs.
  3. To have successfully completed at least 3 similar projects in the last 5 years, preferably focused on the justice sector, insolvency, business recovery, judicial administration or economic governance.
  4. To be legally authorized to validate and issue qualification/attendance certificates to trainees.
  5. Demonstrate practical experience in engaging with and listening to stakeholders (e.g., courts, judges, government entities, professional associations).

Key Experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” revised in September 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest. 

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications, but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Consultant Qualification Selection (CQS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 0800 to 1600 hours.

Expressions of interest must be delivered in a written form to the address below (only by mail) until September 16, 2026.

procnotices.notice_text:
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (REOI)

CONSULTANT’S QUALIFICATIONS BASED SELECTION (CQS)

Name of Project

Sustainable, Integrated and Safe Road Infrastructure Project (SISRI)

Loan No./Credit No./Grant No.

IBRD Loan No. 97800-BA

Assignment Title

Construction Supervision Services for Rehabilitation of Main Road MI-108 (M-4), Rebrovac - Kotor Varoš

Procurement Plan Ref. Number

BA-RS-SISRI-CS-CQS-26-1.2.4

Country of Delivery

Bosnia and Herzegovina (Republika Srpska)

The Ministry of Finance and Treasury of Bosnia and Herzegovina (the “Borrower”) has received financing from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) toward the cost of the Sustainable, Integrated and Safe Road Infrastructure Project (SISRI) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for the following consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) comprise construction supervision, project management and contract administration for the rehabilitation of the main road MI-108 (M-4), Rebrovac - Kotor Varoš (Works RFB No. BA-RS-SISRI-W-RFB-26-1.2.2), covering approximately 30.9 km. The Works include rehabilitation and reconstruction of pavement layers; earthworks; draninage and culverts; curbs and roadside works; traffic signage and road markings; road safety equipment; repair and rehabilitation of related structures and ancillary works; temporary traffic management; and environmental, social, occupational health and safety measures.

The Intended Completion Date for the Works is 540 days after the Commencement Date. The Services are expected to commence in coordination with the commencement of the Works and to cover the construction period and the related completion, close-out and Defects Liability Period services as specified in the Terms of Reference. The Defects Liability Period under the Works contract is 730 calendar days. The detailed scope, deliverables, level of effort and implementation arrangements are set out in the Terms of Reference.

The Terms of Reference (TOR) for the primary procurement stage for the assignment can be obtained at the address given below.

The Public Company “Republic of Srpska Roads” Ltd. now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to paragraphs 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers: “Procurement Investment Project Financing Goods, Works, Non-Consulting, and Consulting Services, Seventh edition, September 2025” (“the Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

The best qualified firm to carry out the Services will be selected in accordance with the Consultant’s Qualifications Based Selection (CQS) method set out in the Regulations and based on the following criteria:

 Qualification requirements to be met by the Consultant:

1. Core business and general experience: at least seven (5) years of demonstrated experience in construction supervision, project management and/or contract administration of road or transport infrastructure works.

2. Relevant specific experience: successful completion, within the last ten (10) years, of at least two (2) assignments for supervision and contract administration of construction, reconstruction or rehabilitation of paved public roads of similar nature and complexity; at least one such assignment should have involved a road section or combined road sections of not less than approximately 20 km.

3. Similar technical scope: demonstrated firm-level experience supervising asphalt pavement rehabilitation/reconstruction, earthworks, drainage and culverts, curbs and roadside works, traffic signage and road markings, road safety equipment, related structures, temporary traffic management under live traffic conditions, and environmental and social requirements.

4. Technical and managerial capability: demonstrated organizational and management capacity for quality assurance/quality control, supervision of materials testing, measurement and certification of works, progress and cost control, contract administration, environmental and social compliance, occupational health and safety monitoring, and regular reporting.

5. Previous experience with World Bank or other international financial institution (IFI/MDB)-financed road infrastructure projects and related contract administration procedures will be considered an asset.

6. Experience in Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Western Balkans or comparable legal, climatic and operating environments will be considered and asset.

Interested Consultants should submit a concise company profile and evidence of relevant assignments, including the client, country, scope, duration, implementation period, value of the supervised works where available, the Consultant’s role, and client contact details for verification. In the case of an association, the Expression of Interest should clearly state the form and proposed role of each member/partner.

The qualifications and experience of individual Key Experts shall not be evaluated at the REOI stage and CVs of Key Experts are not required with the Expression of Interest.

Evaluation criteria

Consultants meeting the minimum qualification requirements set out above will be evaluated and ranked on the basis of their demonstrated qualifications and relevant experience related to the assignment. The evaluation will be based on the information submitted in the Expressions of Interest and in accordance with the following criteria:

  1. Core business, general experience and organizational capacity of the firm (20%)
  2. Relevant experience in supervision and contract administration of road projects of similar nature, scope and complexity (60%)
  3. Technical and managerial capability demonstrated through previous assignments (20%)

Further information can be obtained at the address below during regular business hours.

Expressions of interest must be delivered in a written form to the address below (in person, by mail, or by e-mail) by 15 September 2026 at 10.00 am.

procnotices.notice_text:
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES- FIRMS SELECTION)

Country: Grenada

Name Of Project: Caribbean Resilient Renewable Energy Infrastructure Investment Facility (RREIIF)

Assignment Title: Top of Form

Environmental and Social Impact Assessment (ESIA) for Dual Circuit Transmission lines, substations and solar PV.

Bottom of Form

Reference No.: GD-GRENADA MCRERE-566028-CS-CQS

The Government of Grenada has received financing from the World Bank towards the costs of the Caribbean Resilient Renewable Energy Infrastructure Investment Facility (RREIIF) and intends to apply part of the proceeds to eligible payments for consulting services under the project to support the ESIA for the Dual Circuit Transmission lines, substations and solar PV.

The consulting services (“the Services”) will be responsible for assessing the environmental and social impacts of the proposed transmission lines, substations (the project) and the potential Solar PV farm with associated Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) at Pearls through an Environmental and Social Impact Assessment (ESIA) and provide mitigation measures in an Environmental and Social Management Plan (ESMP). The ESMP will be used by the Owners Engineer and design, construction, and operational contractors of the Project according to the policies of the World Bank and the Ministry of Climate Resilience.

The Contract duration is Five (5) months.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following website: www.procurement.gd  or through our E-Procurement Portal https://in-tendhost.co.uk/gnd/aspx/HOME

The Central Procurement Unit acting on behalf of The Ministry of Climate Resilience now invites eligible firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The criteria for selecting the Consultant are:

Firm Requirements

  • The firm should have a minimum of 4-5 years of demonstrated experience in conducting ESIAs and ESMPs for infrastructure projects. 
  • The firm must have prior experience in the energy sector, and ideally in electricity transmission and distribution infrastructure projects and/or solar projects. It should be able to demonstrate completion of at least one to two ESIAs of comparable nature, with references and project descriptions included in the proposal. 

Team Lead/ Environmental Specialist

  • Master's Degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Natural Resource Management, or a related field. 
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of professional experience in environmental assessment and management.  
  • Minimum of three (3) years of project and team management experience.

Social Development Specialist

  • Master's Degree in Social Sciences, Sociology, Anthropology, Development Studies, Social Development, or a related field.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of professional experience in social impact assessment and social risk management.
  • Familiarity with the World Bank Environmental and Social Standards (ESS), particularly ESS1, ESS2, ESS4, ESS5, and ESS10.

General Experience

  • Experience working in Small Island Developing States (SIDS) or the Caribbean region would be an advantage.

The attention of interested Consultants (firms) is drawn Section III, paragraph 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, Sixth Edition, February 2025 (“the Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

A consultant will be selected in accordance with the Individual Consultant Qualification Selection method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

Expressions of Interest must be submitted via the E-Procurement portal (https://in-tendhost.co.uk/gnd/aspx/HOME, on or before September 24, 2026

Further information can be obtained from donica.modeste@procurement.gov.gd between 09:00 and 15:00 hours Monday to Friday.

REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS

CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION

Republic of Serbia

Sava and Drina Rivers Corridors Integrated Development Program (SDIP)

Project ID No. P168862

Assignment Title:

SUPERVISION OF REHABILITATION WORKS ON THE GALOVICA CANAL

Reference No. SER-SDIP-QCBS-CS-26-45

The Republic of Serbia has received financing from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) (“World Bank”) towards the cost of the Sava and Drina Rivers Corridors Integrated Development Program, Phase I project, and intends to apply part of proceeds for consultancy services.

The general goal of the preparation of technical documentation is to increase the efficiency and safety of the operation of the pumping station and the gate, bearing in mind their importance for the effective protection of agricultural and urban areas within the framework of hydromelioration system, and especially taking into account the increased urbanization, especially along the downstream part of the stream, including the amount of atmospheric and purified used water that is discharged into the canal network. The consulting services (“the Services”) includes preparation of following:

  • Hydrological-hydraulic study;
  • Conceptual Design for the reconstruction and extension of the Nova Galovica pumping station;
  • Feasibility study with Preliminary Design for the reconstruction and extension of the Nova Galovica pumping station;
  • Construction Permit Design for the reconstruction and extension of the Nova Galovica pumping station;
  • Preliminary Design for the rehabilitation of the gate on the Nova Galovica canal, km 20+181.

The detailed Terms of Reference for the above referenced Services are posted on the website of the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Water Management (MAFWM)/Republic Directorate for Water at:

https://rdvode.gov.rs/poslovi/nabavke/projekat-integrisanog-razvoja-koridora-save-i-drine/

The Central Fiduciary Unit (CFU) of the Ministry of Finance now invites eligible Consulting firms (“Consultants”) to submit Proposals in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

The procurement process will be conducted through Direct RFP, shorten Quality and Cost-based Selection procedures and in a Full Technical Proposal (FTP) format as described in respective RFP, in accordance with the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (July 2016, revised November 2017 and August 2018),  and is open to all eligible Consultants as defined in the Procurement Regulations.

Interested eligible Consultants may obtain further information from the Central Fiduciary Unit of the Ministry of Finance (CFU) and inspect the request for proposals from 09:00 to 15:00 hours at the address given.

The request for proposals documents in English will be delivered to interested eligible Consultants upon their request sent by email.

The request for proposals will be provided by the CFU by email.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to paragraphs 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers – Procurement in Investment Project Financing Goods, Works, Non-Consulting and Consulting Services (July 2016, revised November 2017 and August 2018) (“the Regulations”) setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest. 

Deadline for submission of Proposals is October 14, 2026, 12:00 hours, noon, local time. Late Proposals will be rejected.

procnotices.project_name: Lebanon Green Agrifood Transformation for Economic Recovery (GATE)
procnotices.bid_description: Website for Green Plan
procnotices.contact_address: Beirut, Lebanon
procnotices.contact_organization: Green Plan
procnotices.notice_text:
1. The Republic of Lebanon (The Borrower) represented by the Council for Development and Reconstruction (CDR) has received a loan from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (World Bank) in the amount of US$ 200 million for the Green, Agri-food Transformation for Economic Recovery Project (GATE) – N°: 9576-LB

The Council for Development and Reconstruction (CDR), has delegated the implementation and management of sub-component 2.1 of the Project to the Green Plan (GP). The GP intends to apply part of the proceeds of this loan for eligible payments for the consultancy services to be procured under the project.

The consulting services comprise the development of a website for the Green Plan.

 

2. Objective of the assignment

The objective of this assignment is to design, develop, and deploy a secure, scalable, and user-friendly website that:

® Promotes Green Plan programs and activities and Gate Project activities

® Serves as the official communication platform for the Green Plan, including the webpage development of GATE Project;

® Ensures public access to project information, progress reports, …

® Enhances stakeholder engagement and communication by providing access to project information, updates, and communication channels.

® Facilitates grievance management by enabling stakeholders to submit grievances through a dedicated Grievance Redress Mechanism (GRM);

® Enables efficient internal content management by non-technical staff.

 

3. Scope of Services

The Consultant shall provide all services required for the successful implementation of the assignment, including but not limited to: requirements analysis, system design, UX/UI design, prototyping, system development, CMS implementation, configuration of functional modules, integration of dashboards, GIS and external systems, testing and quality assurance, deployment and go-live support, training and capacity building, warranty, maintenance, technical support, and preparation of all documentation and handover materials required for final acceptance.

The assignment shall be implemented in the following phases:

- Phase I: Requirements Analysis and System Design

- Phase II: System Development and Configuration

- Phase III: Testing, Deployment, and Go-Live

- Phase IV: Training and Capacity Building

- Phase V: Warranty, Maintenance, and Technical Support

These phases describe the implementation sequence only and shall not be interpreted as payment milestones.

 

4. Invitation for Expressions of Interest

The Green Plan now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. Consultant brochures may also be included in the Expression of Interest (EOI).

 

5. Evaluation Criteria

Expressions of Interest will be evaluated using a 100-point scoring system based on the following criteria and weights:

Criterion 1: General experience of the firm (30/100)

This criterion assesses the firm’s overall experience and track record, including years of relevant experience and the number and type of websites successfully delivered.  Criterion 2: Experience in Similar Assignments within the last 10 years (25/100)

This criterion assesses the firm's experience in successfully delivering assignments of similar nature, scope and complexity to the required services. Similar assignments may include, but are not limited to, website design and development, CMS implementation and customization, online forms, interactive website functionalities, and website maintenance and technical support.

The Firm shall provide details of its own similar contracts, including, for each reference project, the client's name, project title, a brief description of the services provided, website URL(s) (where applicable), CMS/platform used, completion date, and contract value.

- Criterion 3: Qualifications and Experience of Key Experts (25/100)

The proposed scoring under this criterion would be:

1. Team Leader (Key Expert) (15/25)

- University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.

- Minimum 7 years of professional experience in website design, development, and implementation.

- Minimum 5 years of professional experience in managing and delivering similar website development assignments, including CMS-based and multilingual websites.

2. Website Designer (Key Expert) (10/25)

- University degree or equivalent qualification in Web Design, Graphic Design, Computer Science, or a related field.

- Minimum 7 years of professional experience in designing user-friendly and responsive websites.

- Minimum 5 years of professional experience in designing modern website interfaces, including multilingual and mobile-friendly websites.

Alternatively, the REOI evaluation could remain limited to the consulting firm's experience and capacity, with information on available technical resources provided only for reference, as currently reflected in the REOI.

Criterion 4: Experience with Government Institutions, Donor-Funded Projects and NGOs within the last 10 years (20/100)

This criterion assesses the firm's experience in providing similar services to government institutions, donor-funded projects, international organizations, and non-governmental organizations (NGOs). It evaluates the firm's familiarity with the working environment, requirements and standards typically associated with such organizations.

The firm shall provide relevant portfolios and supporting documents to substantiate the information provided under the above evaluation criteria. Such documents may include, where applicable, website links, project references, completion certificates, client references, or other evidence demonstrating the Applicant’s experience and qualifications.

The Expression of Interest should not exceed 50 pages.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs 3.13, 3.15, and 3.16 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” (February 2025), which set forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications but should clearly indicate whether the association is in the form of a joint venture or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract if selected.

The selection will be conducted using the Consultant’s Qualification-Based Selection (CQS) method in accordance with the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (November 2020).

Further information may be obtained in writing during office hours, from 08:30–15:00 (Beirut local time) by email at procurement.gp.gate@gmail.com.

Expressions of Interest must be submitted electronically to: procurement.gp.gate@gmail.com

Deadline for submission: Monday, 5 October 2026 at 12:00 noon (Beirut local time).

procnotices.notice_text:
MINISTERIO DE PRODUCCIÓN SOSTENIBLE, MEDIO AMBIENTE Y AGUA

PROGRAMA DE GESTIÓN RESILIENTE DEL AGUA PARA

RIEGO COMUNITARIO Y FAMILIAR

P178861 - CONTRATO DE PRÉSTAMO N° 9643-BO

 

SOLICITUD DE EXPRESIONES DE INTERÉS

Organismo Ejecutor:

Ministerio de Producción Sostenible, Medio Ambiente y Agua, a través de la Unidad de Coordinación del Programa Piloto de Resiliencia Climática (UCP – PPCR)

Dirección:

Oficinas de la UCP - PPCR, calle Fernando Guachalla, Edificio Nicole N° 2186 entre Ecuador y Sánchez Lima, Zona Sopocachi de la ciudad de La Paz.

País:

Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia

Nombre del Proyecto:

Proyecto de Gestión Resiliente del Agua para Riego Comunitario y Familiar P178861 - CONTRATO DE PRÉSTAMO N° 9643-BO

Servicios a Contratar:

SERVICIO DE FORTALECIMIENTO ORGANIZACIONAL Y ASISTENCIA TÉCNICA PRODUCTIVA (FORATP) PAQUETE 4: “CONSTRUCCIÓN SISTEMA DE RIEGO COMUNIDAD LA PALCA (SIMÓN BOLIVAR)-POROMA” Y “CONSTRUCCIÓN SISTEMA DE RIEGO COMUNIDAD SUMALA SECTOR KOLLPA PAMPA - ICLA”

Período comprendido de los Servicios:

La consultoría tendrá una duración de 900 días calendario, computables a partir de la fecha de la ORDEN DE INICIO DEL SERVICIO DE CONSULTORÍA.

Fuente de Financiamiento:

Banco Mundial – BIRF- 9643-BO

Código del Proceso - STEP:

BO-UCP-PPCR-569588-CS-CQS

Fecha de publicación de la SEI:

1 de septiembre de 2026

Fecha límite de recepción de Expresión de Interés:

16 de septiembre de 2026, hasta horas 15:30 p.m.

Esta Invitación Incluye:

Anexo I - Términos de Referencia

Anexo II – Conflicto de Interés

Anexo III - Fraude y Corrupción

 

Estimados señores:

 

  1. El Programa de GESTION RESILIENTE DEL AGUA PARA RIEGO COMUNITARIO Y FAMILIAR a través del P178861 - CONTRATO DE PRÉSTAMO N° 9643-BO, tiene como objetivo la gestión integrada de recursos hídricos con enfoque de cuenca e incrementar la resiliencia ante la variabilidad climática de familias rurales vulnerables en microcuencas seleccionados. Sus objetivos específicos son: i) Apoyar a las familias más vulnerables en el acceso a agua para riego y el uso eficiente del recurso hídrico como respuesta al déficit hídrico, a través de la implementación de sistemas de riego menor y el fortalecimiento de la gestión y organización, para contribuir a la seguridad alimentaria. ii) Contribuir a asegurar la disponibilidad de agua para la conservación y recuperación de cuencas, a través de proyectos de manejo integral de cuencas (forestación, manejo de praderas nativas, vigiñas de infiltración, etc.) en cuencas con alta demanda hídrica y con riesgos de escasez hídrica, iii) Proteger las áreas productivas vulnerables a través de proyectos de gestión de riesgos (barreras vivas acompañadas de obras de encauzamiento, muros de hormigón ciclópeo y hormigón, diques longitudinales, etc.) que regulen, conduzcan y minimicen los impactos producidos por las inundaciones, torrenteras y crecidas,  iv) Promover una nueva Cultura del Agua para la Vida en el área de intervención del Programa, a través de acciones de formación, capacitación y sensibilización en niños, jóvenes, productores, regantes, técnicos y profesionales de los Gobiernos Autónomos Municipales (GAM) y Gobiernos Autónomos Departamentales (GAD), y otros actores de la cuenca, que contribuya a garantizar la sostenibilidad de las inversiones, v). Fortalecer la gobernanza local para la gestión y manejo sostenible del agua en las cuencas de intervención del programa, a través de la planificación hídrica estratégica y la elaboración de estudios de inversión que den respuesta a las demandas y necesidades en las cuencas.
  2. El Ministerio de Producción Sostenible, Medio Ambiente y Agua a través de la Unidad de Coordinación del Programa Piloto de Resiliencia Climática (UCP – PPCR), le invita a presentar Expresión de Interés para el servicio de consultoría (en adelante, los “Servicios”), para la ejecución del SERVICIO DE FORTALECIMIENTO ORGANIZACIONAL Y ASISTENCIA TÉCNICA PRODUCTIVA (FORATP) PAQUETE 4: “CONSTRUCCIÓN SISTEMA DE RIEGO COMUNIDAD LA PALCA (SIMÓN BOLIVAR) – POROMA” Y “CONSTRUCCIÓN SISTEMA DE RIEGO COMUNIDAD SUMALA SECTOR KOLLPA PAMPA - ICLA”
  3. Los Términos de Referencia para la consultoría se pueden encontrar en esta invitación y/o solicitar al correo electrónico ppcr.contrataciones3@gmail.com o descargar de la página del SICOES https://www.sicoes.gob.bo/portal/index.php, registrado con número de CUCE 26-0041-27-1685466-1-1
  4. El Ministerio de Producción Sostenible, Medio Ambiente y Agua a través de la Unidad de Coordinación del Programa Piloto de Resiliencia Climática (UCP – PPCR), invita a las firmas consultoras elegibles e interesadas (en delante "Consultores") a manifestar su interés en proporcionar los Servicios. Los Consultores interesados deben proporcionar información que demuestre que tienen las calificaciones requeridas y la experiencia relevante para prestar los Servicios.
  5. En el caso de firmas que tengan la intención de conformar una APCA (Asociaciones en Participación Asociación en Participación, Consorcio o Asociación), deberán presentar su carta de intención de conformación que indique los porcentajes de participación de cada firma asociada e identifique a la firma líder.
  6. Los criterios a ser valorados para la conformación de la Lista Corta son los siguientes:

 

  1. Fotocopia NIT y SEPREC o documento equivalente para consultoras extranjeras
  2. Identificación de la Firma (a ser presentado en el Formulario (DOC-1).
  3. Experiencia específica: acreditar experiencia de los últimos 10 años, de los cuales deberá contar con un mínimo de 3 (tres) contratos similares relacionados con la consultoría (*). Cada contrato debe haberse realizado por un plazo igual o mayor a 6 meses, los cuales deberán estar declarados en el Formulario DOC-2, adjuntando fotocopias simples que respalden los servicios de consultoría declarados.

(*) las consultorías relacionadas son:

 

  1. 3.1. Servicios de Acompañamiento y/o Asistencia técnica de proyectos de Riego Tecnificado
  2. 3.2. Servicios de Acompañamiento y/o Asistencia técnica de proyectos de Riego y/o cuenca
  3. 3.3. Servicios de Supervisión de Acompañamiento y/o Asistencia técnica en riego tecnificado, riego y/o cuenca
  4. 3.4. Servicios de Supervisión en proyectos de inversión en riego

(**) Según la tipología de proyecto de la presente expresión de interés, se valorará preferentemente la experiencia de las mismas características.

7. Las Firmas Consultoras interesadas deberán adjuntar a su manifestación a Expresión de Interés, los Formularios DOC-1 y DOC-2 debidamente completado, así como la documentación de respaldo presentada en la Expresión de Interés.

8. La Propuesta Técnica (Lógica del Enfoque Técnico, Metodología, Plan de Trabajo, Expertos Clave) y Propuesta Financiera no serán evaluados en la etapa de expresión de interés.

9. La expresión de interés de los consultores interesados es requerida bajo el párrafo 7.11 de la Sección VII de las Regulaciones de Adquisiciones para Prestatarios en Proyectos de Inversión, del Banco Mundial Quinta Edición septiembre de 2023 (“Regulaciones de Adquisiciones”). De igual forma, se llama la atención de los Consultores interesados sobre la Sección III, párrafos 3.14, 3.16 y 3.17 de las “Regulaciones de Adquisiciones”, que establecen la política del Banco Mundial sobre conflicto de interés.

10. Se seleccionará una Firma Consultora de acuerdo con el método de Selección de Calificación de Consultores (SCC) descrito en las Regulaciones de Adquisiciones. En esta primera etapa, únicamente se evaluará la capacidad legal y la experiencia relevante de la firma (Formularios DOC-1 y DOC-2).

11. Las consultas y solicitudes de aclaración al presente llamado a Expresiones de Interés podrán realizarlo por medio escrito hasta cuatro (4) días calendario después del presente llamado, mismas que serán atendidas hasta nueve (9) días calendario antes de la fecha límite de manifestación a Expresiones de Interés y comunicadas a través del SICOES en el CUCE correspondiente.

12. Las Expresiones de Interés deberán ser entregadas en formato físico y digital (personalmente o Courier), hasta horas 15:30 p.m. (hora local) de fecha 16 de septiembre de 2026 en la siguiente dirección:

Oficinas de la UCP - PPCR, ubicada en la calle Fernando Guachalla, Edificio Nicole N° 2186 entre Ecuador y Sánchez Lima, Zona Sopocachi de la ciudad de La Paz. El Programa no se responsabilizará por Expresiones de Interés que lleguen con posterioridad a la fecha y hora indicada; asimismo no se devolverá la documentación.

13. Esta Invitación Incluye los Formularios DOC 1 y DOC 2, Anexo I - Términos de Referencia, Anexo II - Conflicto de Interés y Anexo III - Fraude y Corrupción

La Paz, 1 de septiembre de 2026
